```esql
FROM employees
| KEEP emp_no
| INLINE STATS c = COUNT(*) WHERE emp_no IN (FROM employees | SORT emp_no ASC | LIMIT 3 | KEEP emp_no)
| WHERE emp_no <= 10005
| SORT emp_no
```

| 10002 | 3 |
| 10003 | 3 |
| 10004 | 3 |
| 10005 | 3 |
